observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of a car alternator held in hand, with visible part numbers and markings on the top cover.
Photo 1 shows the alternator from a side angle, revealing the fan housing and mounting brackets, with some plastic wrapping nearby.
Photo 2 shows a top-down view of the alternator, with the same markings as in photo 0, and a clear view of the two terminal posts labeled 'B+' and 'B2'.
The alternator appears to be used, with some dust and wear visible on the housing.
The part number 'A 001 540 02 07' is visible on the top cover in photo 0.
The brand 'Mercedes-Benz' is not visibly printed on the alternator, but the part number format is consistent with Mercedes-Benz OEM parts.
The seller claims 'All model of Mercedes Benz alternators are available direct tokunbo', implying used imported parts.

claims.claim: All model of Mercedes Benz alternators are available direct tokunbo
claims.evidence: The photos show only one alternator. The seller's claim about availability of all models cannot be verified from the images alone.
The part number 'A 001 540 02 07' visible in photo 0 is a known Mercedes-Benz OEM part number.

risks.risk: The alternator may be damaged internally or not functional despite appearing intact externally.
risks.proof: A video showing the alternator spinning and producing voltage when tested with a multimeter or connected to a battery.

risks.risk: The alternator may have been salvaged from a wrecked vehicle and have hidden damage or corrosion.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the internal components (rotor, stator, diodes) or a video of the alternator being tested under load.

risks.risk: The alternator may not be genuine Mercedes-Benz or may be a counterfeit part.
risks.proof: A photo of the part number and any hologram or serial number on the housing, compared with official Mercedes-Benz documentation.

proof_requests: Video of the alternator being tested for output voltage and functionality.
Close-up photo of the internal components or a test report.
Photo of the part number and any hologram or serial number for authenticity verification.
response.reason: The alternator is identified by its part number as a Mercedes-Benz unit, but its functionality and condition cannot be confirmed from the photos alone. Hidden risks such as internal damage or counterfeit status require additional proof before pricing can be determined.
